heading: Liability for defective products
title: Liability for defective products
text: The manufacturer of a product shall be liable to a consumer for damages proximately caused by a characteristic of the product that renders the product defective when such damage arose from a reasonably anticipated use of the product.
text_raw: The manufacturer of a product shall be liable to a consumer for damages proximately caused by a characteristic of the product that renders the product defective when such damage arose from a reasonably anticipated use of the product.

heading: Filing of claims before Consumer Court (15-Day Written Notice)
title: Filing of claims before Consumer Court (15-Day Written Notice)
text: (1) A consumer who has suffered damage, or an authority on behalf of consumers, may file a claim before the Consumer Court having territorial jurisdiction: Provided that the consumer shall first give a written notice of fifteen days to the manufacturer or service provider.
